meaning:
§ Nob = "high place"
a priestly city in the Benjamin situated on some eminence north but near Jerusalem

elsewhere.note: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said to him, “Why are you alone, and no man with you?”
This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
